verdict.rationale: Docs describe building segments (e.g., 'Paying Customers', 'Have not logged in recently') from attribute conditions and events, and automations can trigger when profiles join segments, implying live-updating segment membership as data changes. However, tags-based segmentation isn't explicitly documented, and one community post notes frustration with 'lack of code-based flexibility for defining segments,' suggesting some limitations in segment logic sophistication. Missing for 10: explicit tag-criteria documentation, independent confirmation of real-time segment recalculation, and rebuttal to the code-flexibility complaint.
